payload.title: Generated wiki pages stop overwriting a person's edit
payload.description: Finding: `knowledge_wiki/sync.py` `_plan_page` UPDATE rewrites a draft page's front matter and body in place, so a person's draft edit is lost. REVISE only writes beside a live page. Decision proposed: the node is the source of truth for name, description and aliases, and the page has an optional person-written section the sync never touches. A page a person edited is reported and left alone otherwise. Spec the rule in `docs/public-wiki.md`.
